notes: GAAP city, FY ended 2023-09-30. Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p5); roll-forward 42,469,517 + 39,566,774 - 33,291,716 + 1,202,871 - 2,446,751 = 47,500,695. Ending cash = governmental funds balance sheet cash and cash equivalents 35,764,551 (p4); certificates of deposit 6,339,522 as ending_investments; county treasurer cash 320,630 (p4) is a separate line not added. Business-type = enterprise funds Total column (Landfill, Electric, Combined System Utilities) of the proprietary statement (p7); internal service funds (Health Insurance, IT; p6-7 and combining p21-22) excluded as in FY2024. Contributions in aid of construction 240,739 in business_type.other_financing; loss on disposal (442,187) kept as a negative nonoperating line (category Loss on Disposal of Assets, user 2026-11-06). Business roll: 250,501,869 + 93,164,115 - 88,940,679 + 240,739 = 254,966,044. Landfill 'Other revenue' 12,119 is counted in Landfill charges for services on the Statement of Activities (p2), so charges for services. Payments in lieu of taxes 3,967,590 kept as printed (nonoperating expense, Other Taxes Paid). Detail: budget schedules for General, Street, Museum and Debt Service funds (p12-16, budgetary basis, so they differ slightly from the GAAP fund statement) and the nonmajor combining statement per fund column (p17-20, 20 funds; Total column not used). Capital outlay lines labelled with a function only where the fund name names one; others 'Capital Outlay'. Museum Fund capital outlay actual printed '-' (recorded 0 to keep the 280,000 budget). Component unit (Community Redevelopment Authority) skipped. No schedules appear cut off by the trim. Read pages 1-22 of 22
